title: Lion at Home
audience: My family (mom, uncle, cousins in Addis and Gonder) in Telegram/WhatsApp groups on phones; secondarily friends and my cohort on TikTok/Instagram who don't speak Amharic
intent: Laugh at Babeye's punchline, then feel the warmth under it: Gonder was the one place I felt at home enough to be the lion

lines: Images: FLUX.2 klein (Cloudflare Workers AI) · Voice: Gemini TTS · Edit: FFmpeg, driven by a storyboard in code
A true family story, told with the consent of the people in it

shots.reason: Set up the nickname, the film's title and payoff, and introduce the uncle who coined it.

keyframe.prompt: In a cosy living room, the smiling uncle points playfully at the small boy who stands on the sofa pretending to be a lion, cushions scattered, cheerful

motion.prompt: the boy roars and the uncle laughs

narration.text: አጎቴ መሐሪ ለኔ የሰጠኝ ቅጽል ስም ነበረው፦ «የቤት አንበሳ፣ የዱር ጨዋ»።
narration.english: My uncle Mehari had a nickname for me: "a lion at home, a gentleman outside."

shots.reason: Show the 'gentleman outside' half, so the contrast is visible.

keyframe.prompt: In a bright school classroom, the small boy sits perfectly upright at a wooden desk, hands folded, angelic polite smile, other children blurred around him

narration.text: በትምህርት ቤት ሳለሁ ከሁሉ በላይ ጸጥተኛና ጨዋ ልጅ ነበርኩ።
narration.english: At school I was the quietest, most polite kid you ever met.

shots.music_cue: music holds a polite single note

shots.reason: Name the place that felt most like home, and the journey there.

keyframe.prompt: Inside a small airplane, the boy presses his face to the window, his mother beside him smiling, green Ethiopian highlands and clouds below

narration.text: ነገር ግን እንደ ቤቴ የሚሰማኝ አያቴ ቤት ጎንደር ነበረ፤ ከአዲስ አበባ በሰማይ እንበር ነበር።
narration.english: But the place that felt most like home was my grandparents' house in Gonder. We flew there from Addis.

shots.reason: Establish Gonder and the grandparents' house: the stage for the story.

keyframe.prompt: A warm family house with a green gate and a courtyard in Gonder, bougainvillea on the wall, the old stone castles of Gonder on the hill behind, afternoon light

narration.text: እና በዚያ ቤት ውስጥ፣ አንበሳው ነቃ።
narration.english: And in that house, the lion woke up.

shots.reason: The ruckus: make the havoc concrete and funny.

keyframe.prompt: The boy runs through the living room yelling with joy, a drinking glass falling off a table mid-air, a cracked window behind him, a cat jumping out of the way

narration.text: አንድ ጊዜ ስሄድ መነጽር ሰብሬ፣ መስኮት ሰንጥቄ፣ ቤቱን በጩኸት ሞላሁት። እውነተኛ ተንኮለኛ።
narration.english: One visit I broke glasses, cracked a window, and yelled through the whole house. A true menace.

shots.reason: Introduce Babeye at the moment his patience runs out.

keyframe.prompt: The grandfather stands up from a patterned sofa with a stern, comic expression, one eyebrow raised

narration.english: My grandfather, Babeye, had finally had enough.

shots.reason: Explain Habesha discipline so non-family viewers get the joke.

keyframe.prompt: Still life on a tiled floor: a plastic slipper, a leather belt, and the grandfather's hand with two fingers ready to pinch, comic storybook framing

narration.text: በሀበሻ ቤቶች፣ ቅጣት ጫማ፣ ቀበቶ፣ ወይም ቆንጥጦ ነው። የባቤዬ ምርጥ፡ በነርቭ ላይ መቆንጠጥ።
narration.english: In Habesha homes, discipline is a slipper, a belt, or a pinch. Babeye's favourite: a pinch on the thigh.

shots.reason: The turn: a spoiled boy meets discipline for the first time and reacts on instinct.

keyframe.prompt: Comic storybook moment: the small boy, eyes squeezed shut, throws a tiny punch into his grandfather's belly; the grandfather's eyes go wide with surprise, comic motion lines

narration.text: ወላጆቼ ፈጽሞ ቀጥበውኝ አያውቁም። አሳመመኝ፣ ደነገጥኩ፣ እና በቀጥታ ሆዱ ላይ መታሁት።
narration.english: My parents had never punished me. It hurt, I panicked, and I punched him right in the stomach.

shots.reason: The punchline: Babeye's line to my mother, the sentence the film exists for.

keyframe.prompt: The grandfather, catching his breath with a hand on his belly, turns to the mother in the doorway with a proud astonished grin; the mother covers her mouth, laughing

narration.text: ትንፋሹን ሰብስቦ ወደ እናቴ ዞረና፦ «ፓፓ! ሁልዬ፣ ወንድ ወልደሻል!» አላት።
narration.english: He gasped, turned to my mom and said: "Wow! Hule, you've given birth to a real man!"

shots.music_cue: beat of silence, then warm theme returns

shots.reason: Bridge to today: the story lives on as family ritual.

keyframe.prompt: Today, the whole family around a dinner table with injera and coffee, everyone laughing, the young man in the middle covering his face in embarrassment

narration.text: አሁን ይህ በየቤተሰቡ እራት ላይ የሚወራ ታሪክ ሆኗል።
narration.english: Now it's the story told at every family dinner.

shots.reason: Pay off the nickname with its real meaning: home is where you're free to be yourself.

keyframe.prompt: The young man and his very old grandfather sitting side by side on a patterned sofa, laughing together, warm evening light, balloons in the background

narration.text: በቤት ውስጥ አንበሳ። ምክንያቱም ቤት አንበሳ ለመሆን ነፃነት የነበረኝ ብቸኛ ቦታ ስለነበር ነው።
narration.english: A lion at home. Because home was the one place I was free to be one.
